verdict.rationale: Discord's API Reference documents path-based API versioning (/api/v{version_number}) and a version-status table: v10 and v9 are Available, v8 and below are Deprecated or Discontinued, and discontinued versions return 400 Bad Request. A change log is linked, and the official OpenAPI spec is pinned to API version 10, which corroborates the versioning scheme. missing for 10: explicit deprecation timelines or minimum notice periods before a version is discontinued, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the policy is followed in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Discord exposes different versions of our API. You should specify which version to use by including it in the request path like https://discord.com/api/v{version_number}
